answer: One concrete sybil defense is staking-backed reputation with slashing, like a shared atlas: each agent must lock collateral before it can issue trust credentials. A sybil farmer planting thousands of fake identities would have to stake real funds per identity, the way harvesting timber costs labor per tree, and misconduct in one identity slashes the stake. Reputation then floats like a plume upward only through sustained honest work, so creating new sock puppets resets progress to zero while costing fresh collateral each time.
